description.value: Provisions is an all-day neighbourhood café in the heart of Whistler Village, backed by the Toptable Group and open since 2023. It offers a full espresso bar with custom-roasted coffee, daily fresh-baked pastries, made-to-order breakfast and lunch dishes, and slow-roasted rotisserie chicken — serving both dine-in and takeout. A natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the village, with online ordering available for both its Whistler and Kitsilano locations.
